status: frozen scope before implementation; F6 pending
conditions: Optional !, then lampOn/memo/hatchOpen/fanOn/signal, optional = literal true/false/0/1/2. No expressions, templates, clocks, weather or derived state.
actions: literal set on the four listed state keys
emit an event already declared on that same noun
response: Existing engine LineData arrays: command, reply and optional ok/err/dim; bounded text and existing supported placeholders only
protected: All non-handler data, ids, order, noun kinds, verb/event inventories, state defaults, tuning, geometry, dialogue, rules/effects, rewards, transport, all unrelated cables remain unchanged. The sensor wave's existing sbx.pulse effect is retained exactly once in its native handler and cannot be added elsewhere or edited.

semantics.cases: In stored order; first matching case only; case conditions observe current state.
semantics.actions: In stored order; each condition observes changes from preceding actions; no transaction or implicit once semantics.
semantics.cables: Engine signal arrival after 150ms; live glow clears after 500ms; new emissions schedule further native callbacks.
semantics.once: No reward/once-effect authoring. Hatch already-open case demonstrates state-based repeat suppression; literal assignments are otherwise repeatable.
semantics.reset: Cancel queued callbacks, reset state and wiring to document defaults; no external timers survive.
semantics.restore: Cancel queued callbacks then use SceneModel.restore; state/wiring persistence follows the existing runtime.
semantics.savedWiring: Source cable changes are defaults for new/reset Sandbox states. Existing saved connections and cuts continue to override matching source connections; a moved source endpoint adds its new default beside a retained saved connection. No player-save migration.
semantics.cycles: Reject any possible directed verb/event cable cycle conservatively, even when a condition might break it. After native saved/default merging, validate actual preview links again; unsafe restore cancels pending work, resets the laboratory to current source defaults and reports the error. Native player-save restore semantics are unchanged.

operations: bounded cable endpoint/verb editing with stable cable ids
exclusions: No arbitrary TypeScript, evaluator, effects or reward authoring
No live Game/player storage or active-world mutation
No adding/removing devices, nouns, verbs, events, state keys or cable ids
No editing clocks, watchdogs, guards, networks, dialogue or time/weather conditions
No migration of old saved wiring
No UI claim that opaque controller effects are editable
